int restore_xstate(struct xsave_struct *fx, u64 mask) {
    int ret = 0;

    asm volatile(
        "1:\n"
        "xrstors %0, %1\n"
        "2:\n"
        ".section .fixup,\"ax\"\n"
        "3: mov %w2, %w3\n"
        "   jmp 2b\n"
        ".previous\n"
        ".pushsection __ex_table,\"a\"\n"
        "   .align 8\n"
        "   .quad 1b,3b\n"
        ".popsection"
        :
        : "m"(*fx), "r"(mask), "r"(ret), "i"(EFAULT)
        : "memory");

    return ret;
}

int restore_extended_state(struct xsave_struct *fx, u64 mask) {
    int ret = 0;
    unsigned long flags;

    // Check if xrstors is available and use it if possible
    asm volatile(
        "pushf\n\t"
        "pop %0\n\t"
        "mov %1, %%rax\n\t"
        "mov %2, %%rcx\n\t"
        "xrstors %3, %%rax, %%rcx\n\t"
        "1:\n\t"
        ".L1:\n\t"
        "jmp 1b\n\t"
        "2:\n\t"
        "pushfq\n\t"
        "orl $0x200, (%rsp)\n\t"
        "popfq\n\t"
        "3:\n\t"
        "jmp 2b\n\t"
        "4:\n\t"
        "xor %0, %0\n\t"
        : "=&r" (flags), "+m" (mask)
        : "r" (fx)
        : "rax", "rcx", "memory");

    return ret;
}
